def canonical_url(url):
    """Return a canonical form of the given URL.

    The function accepts only ``http`` or ``https`` URLs.  It lower‑cases
    the scheme and host, removes a fragment identifier, removes a single
    trailing slash from non‑root paths, and preserves the query string
    exactly.  All other URLs or non‑string input raise ``ValueError``.

    Parameters
    ----------
    url : str
        The URL to normalise.

    Returns
    -------
    str
        Canonicalised URL.
    """
    if not isinstance(url, str):
        raise ValueError("URL must be a string")

    # Scheme: http or https (case‑insensitive)
    scheme_sep = "://"
    sep_index = url.find(scheme_sep)
    if sep_index == -1:
        raise ValueError("URL missing scheme separator '://'")
    scheme = url[:sep_index].lower()
    if scheme not in ("http", "https"):
        raise ValueError("Unsupported scheme: %s" % scheme)

    rest = url[sep_index + len(scheme_sep) :]
    # Find host (up to first '/', '?' or '#' or end)
    host_end = len(rest)
    for c in ('/', '?', '#'):
        i = rest.find(c)
        if i != -1:
            host_end = min(host_end, i)
    host_port = rest[:host_end]
    if not host_port:
        raise ValueError("Missing host in URL")
    # Strip username:password@ if present
    if '@' in host_port:
        host_port = host_port.split('@', 1)[1]
    # Split host and optional port
    if ':' in host_port:
        host, port = host_port.split(':', 1)
        host = host.lower()
        host_port = host + ':' + port
    else:
        host_port = host_port.lower()

    # Remaining part after host
    rest_after_host = rest[host_end:]
    # Remove fragment
    if '#' in rest_after_host:
        rest_after_host = rest_after_host.split('#', 1)[0]
    # Split path and query
    if '?' in rest_after_host:
        path, query = rest_after_host.split('?', 1)
    else:
        path = rest_after_host
        query = None
    # path may be empty string; root path is '/'
    if path == '':
        path = '/'
    # Remove single trailing slash from non-root paths
    if path != '/' and path.endswith('/'):
        path = path[:-1]
    # Reconstruct URL
    result = scheme + "://" + host_port + path
    if query is not None:
        result += "?" + query
    return result

# Helper to assert canonical equality

# Basic scheme and host canonicalisation
def test_scheme_host_lowercase():
    assert canonical_url("HTTP://Example.COM")=="http://example.com/"
    assert canonical_url("HtTpS://Example.com:8080/path")=="https://example.com:8080/path"

# Fragment removal
def test_fragment_removal():
    assert canonical_url("http://example.com/path#frag")=="http://example.com/path"

def test_query_preserved():
    assert canonical_url("https://example.com/path?x=1&y=2#frag")=="https://example.com/path?x=1&y=2"

# Trailing slash removal

    assert canonical_url("http://example.com/foo/")=="http://example.com/foo"
    assert canonical_url("http://example.com/")=="http://example.com/"

     assert canonical_url("http://example.com")=="http://example.com/"
